children: Aehr Test Systems’ revenue rose sharply year over year as strong AI-market demand drove higher shipments of systems and contactors. Earnings improved from a year-earlier loss to income, supported by higher sales volume, a more favorable product mix and improved absorption of manufacturing costs.
¹ Reported as “Revenue”. ² Reported as “Net income (loss)”. ³ Reported as “Diluted”.

: Higher shipments of systems and contactors drove revenue growth; package-level burn-in system revenue rose $10.9M, while wafer-level contactors and package-level boards and modules increased a combined $10.9M.
: Asia revenue increased 796% and U.S. revenue rose 83%; Europe and Middle East revenue declined 45%, reflecting fewer FOX-P systems sold.
: Gross margin increased to 47.5% from 33.9%, as greater volume improved labor and overhead absorption and product mix was more favorable.
: R&D expense rose 45%, primarily from higher employment-related and allocated costs following increased headcount; SG&A expense increased 16%.
